scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can ^0055FFsign your name^000000 on almost any rare item you hold.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我可以为你持有的几乎所有稀有物品^0055FF签名^000000。

scripts.text: Tell me more...
scripts.translation: 多说一点...

scripts.text: Sign my items, please!
scripts.translation: 请为我的物品签名！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can put your name on any slotless equipment or weapon.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我可以在任何无插槽的装备或武器上刻上你的名字。

 ~ {2} Zeny
 ~ {3} Zeny per refine

 ~ {2} 泽尼

scripts.text:

I work for free, but...
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, I have 12 hungry children
and a very angry wife.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
唉，我有12个饥饿的孩子
和一个非常愤怒的妻子。

scripts.text:

and a very hungry wife...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]

和一个非常饥饿的妻子...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Show me your items to sign...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
给我看看你要签名的物品...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Nothing is equipped there!
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
那里没有装备任何物品！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, this item's already signed.
I would never touch a master's work.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
唉，这件物品已经签名了。
我绝不会触碰师父的作品。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
A card? Here?!
As I said before, I don't sign items with cards.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
卡片？在这里？！
如我之前所说，我不为插有卡片的物品签名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign slotted items.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
抱歉，我不为有插槽的物品签名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign rental items!
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
抱歉，我不为租赁物品签名！

scripts.translation:
